heading_en: Due Diligence, etc. for Securitization Transactions
summary_ja: 証券化エクスポージャーにリスク・ウェイト計測手法を適用する条件(体制整備等)、満たさない場合の千二百五十パーセント、リスク保持を確認できない場合の三倍の取扱いを定める。
summary_en: Sets the conditions (systems and controls) for applying the securitization RWA methods, a 1,250% risk weight where they are not met, and a tripling of the risk weight where the originator's risk retention cannot be confirmed.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company may apply the methods for measuring credit risk-weighted assets of securitization exposures prescribed in Subsection 2 of the next Section only where it satisfies all of the following conditions. (i) A system necessary for continuously obtaining information on the comprehensive risk characteristics of the securitization exposures held by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company is in place. (ii) A system necessary for obtaining, in a timely manner, information on the comprehensive risk characteristics and performance of the underlying assets of the securitization exposures held by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company is in place. (iii) A system necessary for understanding the structural characteristics of the securitization transactions relating to the securitization exposures held by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company is in place. (iv) Where the Ultimate Designated Parent Company holds exposures relating to a securitization transaction that is excluded from re-securitization transactions under the proviso to Article 1, item (ii)-2, a system necessary for obtaining, in a timely manner, information on the comprehensive risk characteristics and performance of the underlying assets relating to the securitization exposures that constitute all or part of the underlying assets of that securitization transaction is in place. (v) Management rules, etc. for satisfying all of the conditions in the preceding items have been prepared.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the next Section, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company shall apply a risk weight of 1,250% to a securitization exposure that does not satisfy any one of the conditions in the items of the preceding paragraph.

In the case of paragraph (1), where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company cannot confirm that the originator of the securitization transaction in which it holds a securitization exposure (excluding the securitization exposures provided in Article 229) (including where the Ultimate Designated Parent Company is the originator) satisfies any of the following conditions, it shall use as the risk weight of that securitization exposure the value obtained by multiplying the risk weight calculated under the provisions of Subsection 2 of the next Section by three (or 1,250% where it exceeds 1,250%), unless it can determine, from the originator's involvement with the original assets, the quality of the original assets and other circumstances, that the original assets were not originated inappropriately. (i) The originator holds all tranches of the securitization exposures in the securitization transaction in equal proportion (where a portion for which the originator does not substantially bear credit risk, by hedging credit risk or otherwise, is deemed not to be held; the same applies hereinafter in this paragraph), and the total amount of those securitization exposures is 5% or more of the total amount of the exposures that are the original assets of the securitization transaction. (ii) The originator holds the most subordinated tranche of the securitization exposures in the securitization transaction, and the total amount of that exposure is 5% or more of the total amount of the exposures that are the original assets of the securitization transaction. (iii) Where the most subordinated tranche of the securitization exposures in the securitization transaction is less than 5%, the originator holds the whole of that tranche and also holds each tranche other than that tranche in equal proportion, and the total amount of those exposures is 5% or more of the total amount of the exposures that are the original assets of the securitization transaction. (iv) It is recognized that, by continuing to hold the securitization exposures in the securitization transaction, the credit risk borne by the originator is equal to or greater than the credit risk where the conditions of the preceding items are satisfied.
